title: Affine etale restriction comparison preserving the adjunction unit
statement: For every family U_h of continuous functors between the full affine etale sites of schemes (for affine morphisms h:Y to X), natural identifications t_h: U_h followed by affine inclusion isomorphic to affine inclusion followed by ordinary etale base change, and left adjoints L_h with specified adjunctions a_h to affine precomposition on sheaves of Type(u+1), there are natural isomorphisms e_h: full-site inverse image followed by affine restriction isomorphic to affine restriction followed by L_h. On an affine object V and section s of a full-site sheaf G, e_h at U_h V carries the restriction along t_h(V) of the full-site unit on s to the affine unit on s. All these data and the explicit section formula are quantified in the Lean statement; no preservation or composition conclusion is asserted here.

proof.text: Restriction rho_S to the full affine etale subsite is an equivalence at the required coefficient universe Type (u+1); use the new larger-universe comparison. Existing inclusion continuity remains supplied by the affine-etale-site-topos module.

Base change is continuous by Scheme.isContinuous_overPullback, the generic declaration underlying the recorded etale continuity lemma. Use sheafPushforwardContinuousComp and sheafPushforwardContinuousIso with t.symm to construct beta: R_h followed by rho_X isomorphic to rho_Y followed by affine direct image. Its section component is restriction along t.hom.

Take alpha to be the inverse mate of beta under the full-site pullback adjunction and a_h. The proved generic inverse-mate lemma makes alpha invertible because rho_X and rho_Y are equivalences. Set e_h=alpha_h inverse.

Evaluate Mathlib unit_mateEquiv_symm at G, V and s. This says the restricted full-site unit equals alpha_h applied to the affine unit. Apply alpha_h inverse and its hom-inverse identity to obtain exactly the unchanged section formula. Assemble the family e_h for all h.
